name: Lighthouse
subtitle: Banjo-Kazooie for iPhone & Vision Pro
localizedDescription: The Lighthouse port of Banjo-Kazooie, running natively on Metal, with the randomizer, online co-op, ROM-hack support and an Apple Vision Pro stereoscopic 3D mode. Ships with no game content: you supply your own Banjo-Kazooie ROM and the app extracts it on device.
